request: Pull HHS COVID-19 Reported Patient Impact and Hospital Capacity by State (Timeseries) from healthdata.gov (dataset g62h-syeh, ~82k rows, daily state observations Jan-2020 through Apr-2024 when reporting ended). One row per state x date. Enrich with utilization_band (numeric_bin on inpatient_beds_utilization: low <0.5 / moderate <0.7 / high <0.85 / crisis >=0.85) and census_region (map_values state -> Northeast/Midwest/South/West/territory). Publish to 'Prep Agent / 25 - HHS Hospital Capacity Timeseries' on Tableau Server for state public-health analysts. healthdata.gov resolves to AWS (15.197.185.55 / 3.33.161.206), not the Socrata FedRAMP NLB — stable from TabPy subprocesses.

sources.name: HHS Hospital Capacity Timeseries
sources.description: HHS COVID-19 Reported Patient Impact and Hospital Capacity by State Timeseries (healthdata.gov dataset g62h-syeh). One row per state x date, ~82k rows total (all 50 states + DC + PR + VI, daily from 2020-01 through 2024-04-27). Fields: state (2-letter), date (daily), critical_staffing_shortage_today_yes/no/not_reported, hospital_onset_covid, inpatient_beds, inpatient_beds_used, inpatient_beds_used_covid, previous_day_admission_adult_covid_confirmed/suspected, previous_day_admission_pediatric_covid_confirmed/suspected, staffed_adult_icu_bed_occupancy, staffed_icu_adult_patients_confirmed_and_suspected_covid, staffed_icu_adult_patients_confirmed_covid, total_adult_patients_hospitalized_confirmed_and_suspected_covid, total_adult_patients_hospitalized_confirmed_covid, total_pediatric_patients_hospitalized_*, total_staffed_adult_icu_beds, inpatient_beds_utilization (0-1 ratio), adult_icu_bed_utilization, adult_icu_bed_covid_utilization, percent_of_inpatients_with_covid. Pulled via Socrata SoQL offset pagination ($limit=5000 per page, 18 pages, cap 90k rows).

args.name: HHS Hospital Capacity Trend
args.features_description: Row-level HHS state-daily hospital-capacity observations (~82k rows, 2020-01 through 2024-04). Fields: state, date, census_region (Northeast/Midwest/South/West/territory), critical_staffing_shortage_today_yes/no, hospital_onset_covid, inpatient_beds, inpatient_beds_used, inpatient_beds_used_covid, previous_day_admission_adult_covid_confirmed/suspected, previous_day_admission_pediatric_covid_confirmed/suspected, staffed_adult_icu_bed_occupancy, staffed_icu_adult_patients_confirmed_covid, total_adult_patients_hospitalized_confirmed_and_suspected_covid, total_adult_patients_hospitalized_confirmed_covid, total_pediatric_patients_hospitalized_confirmed_and_suspected_covid, total_staffed_adult_icu_beds, inpatient_beds_utilization (0-1 ratio), utilization_band (low <0.5 / moderate <0.7 / high <0.85 / crisis >=0.85), adult_icu_bed_utilization, adult_icu_bed_covid_utilization, percent_of_inpatients_with_covid. Plus calendar features parsed from date.
args.stats_description: Long-form HHS hospital-capacity statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over state, census_region, utilization_band). Includes 14-day rolling counts, z-score anomalies vs lifetime baseline (|z|>=2.5 flagged is_anomaly=True), lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Use to identify surge weeks by state/region and shifts in reporting cadence.

outputs.name: HHS Hospital Capacity Detail
outputs.description: Row-level HHS state-daily hospital-capacity timeseries (~82k rows spanning 2020-01 through 2024-04-27 when federal reporting ended). Fields: state, date, census_region (Northeast/Midwest/South/West/territory), critical_staffing_shortage_today (yes/no/not_reported), hospital_onset_covid, inpatient_beds, inpatient_beds_used, inpatient_beds_used_covid, previous_day COVID admissions (adult confirmed/suspected + pediatric confirmed/suspected), staffed_adult_icu_bed_occupancy, ICU COVID patient counts (confirmed + confirmed_and_suspected), total_adult_patients_hospitalized COVID counts, pediatric_patients_hospitalized COVID counts, total_staffed_adult_icu_beds, inpatient_beds_utilization (0-1 ratio), utilization_band (low <0.5 / moderate <0.7 / high <0.85 / crisis >=0.85), adult_icu_bed_utilization, adult_icu_bed_covid_utilization, percent_of_inpatients_with_covid. Plus calendar features. Source: healthdata.gov dataset g62h-syeh. Refresh: weekly (dataset is historical, no new rows expected — schedule kept for archive validation).

outputs.name: HHS Hospital Capacity Stats
outputs.description: Long-form HHS hospital-capacity statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over state, census_region, utilization_band). Includes 14-day rolling counts, z-score anomalies vs lifetime baseline (|z|>=2.5 flagged is_anomaly=True), lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Joinable from Tableau on (dimension, value, year, month). Use to see surge weeks by state/region and shifts in reporting cadence. Source: healthdata.gov g62h-syeh.
